content: Temporal python SDK (temporalio 1.32.0) gives durable execution without hand-written state persistence, but requires running/operating a Temporal cluster (or paying for Cloud). Guidance: for a small team with a single Postgres-centric service whose workflow fits inside the DB boundary, a DB-backed approach is lower friction; Temporal pays off when workflows escape the DB boundary or need multi-tenant isolation. Spec explicitly forbids a separate distributed-lock/orchestration service -> Temporal is out of scope; use Postgres.
